CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Oracle ports to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Oracle ports (TCP: 1521, 2483, 2484).
Risk: These ports handle Oracle Database listener (1521) and SSL/TLS connections (2483-2484). Attackers can target unpatched Oracle services to execute arbitrary code, exfiltrate sensitive corporate/financial data, or disrupt critical database operations.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
